connector.name: Microsoft Teams API
connector.registryDescription: AI-native Microsoft Teams integration - read chats, send messages, search people
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package teams-api. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the maxim-mazurok account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TEAMS_EMAIL
env.description: Corporate email address for Teams authentication

env.name: TEAMS_AUTO
env.description: Set to "true" to use auto-login (macOS + FIDO2)

env.name: TEAMS_LOGIN
env.description: Set to "true" to use interactive browser login (all platforms)

env.name: TEAMS_TOKEN
env.description: Pre-existing Skype token for direct authentication

env.name: TEAMS_REGION
env.description: API region (required with TEAMS_TOKEN, auto-detected otherwise)

env.name: TEAMS_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Middle-tier bearer token for profile resolution

env.name: TEAMS_SUBSTRATE_TOKEN
env.description: Substrate bearer token for people/chat search

env.name: TEAMS_DEBUG
env.description: Set to "true" to use Chrome debug session for token capture

env.name: TEAMS_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to "true" to enable full debug telemetry logging (contributor use; logs all inputs and outputs locally)

env.name: TEAMS_TELEMETRY_PATH
env.description: Override the telemetry output file path (default: platform-appropriate ~/Library/... or ~/.local/share/...)

env.name: TEAMS_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint used by teams_describe_image

env.name: TEAMS_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION_MODEL
env.description: Model name for teams_describe_image (defaults to gpt-4o-mini)
